description: A shell script to perform verified file downloads, including downloading files, checksum verification, GPG signature verification, and cleanup.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Cleanup temporary files and exit with provided status.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Function to download files using available utility (curl, wget, fetch).

methods.name: checksum
methods.description: Function to verify SHA256 checksum using available utility (sha256sum or shasum).

methods.name: runpgp
methods.description: Function to verify GPG signatures if GPG is available.
